newsitem.title: USA: Moody's may cut six Dade Cty, Fla. housing revs.
newsitem.headline: Moody's may cut six Dade Cty, Fla. housing revs.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday it placed on review for possible downgrade six multi-family Dade County, special Housing Revenue Bond programs, that now are rated single A.
There are a total of $9.2 million of bonds outstanding, the rating agency said, adding all six programs are separately collateralized and are special obligations of Dade County.
The issues are secured solely from revenues of the developments, which include Section 8 payments, tenant rentals, and certain other moneys, such as investment income.

The rating agency said recent audited financials and trusteee statements for the programs indicate potential difficulties with regard to ability to pay debt service from operating reveneus and reserve funds.
In four of the six programs, net income after operating expenses, excluding depreciation, is insufficient to pay debt service on the bonds.
Moody's plans to focus on the following credit factors:
--The Authority's overisght of Section 8 based properties.
--The physcial condition and management assessment of the properties as set in the most recent HUD inspections.
--The nature of HAP contracts securing the bodns and the expectation of sufficient revenue streams over the life of the bonds.

The agency added its action was not a result of the Section 8 policy debates in Washington. "At this time HUD has indicated that it will honor its existing Section 8 contracts," it said, in prepared remarks.

Moody's added Dade County's A1 rating for its general obligations was not affected. The Metropolitan Dade County Housing and Urban Development is separate and distinct from the Housing Finance Agency of Dade County, which is also unaffected.
--Dade County Special Housing Revs, Series 1978 A (County Development)
--Dade County Special Housing Revs, Series 1981 A (City of Miami Development--Indenture VIII)
--Dade County Special Housing Revs, Series 1979 A (City of Miami Development Indenture VI)
--Dade County Special Housing Revs, Series 1979 A (County Development - Indenture III)
--Dade County Special Housing Revs, Series 1980 A (City of Miami Development - Indenture V)
--Dade County Special Housing Revs, Series A (City of Miami)
